parrafo_1.es: Beaches Home Solutions es un equipo de handyman y remodelacion con base en Jacksonville Beach, FL, liderado por Joel. Construimos closets, cobertizos, pisos y mejoras exteriores, y reparamos lo que haga falta en tu casa, desde un buzon de madera hasta una pared completa.
parrafo_1.en: Beaches Home Solutions is a handyman and remodeling crew based in Jacksonville Beach, FL, led by Joel. We build closets, sheds, flooring and exterior upgrades, and repair whatever your home needs, from a wooden mailbox to a full wall.

parrafo_2.es: Nuestros clientes repiten lo mismo en Google: puntualidad, comunicacion clara y un trabajo terminado con detalle. 26 reseñas y 5.0 de calificación respaldan ese trabajo.
parrafo_2.en: The same things come up again and again in our Google reviews: punctuality, clear communication and work finished with real attention to detail. 26 reviews and a 5.0 rating back that up.

texto.es: Nos cuentas que necesitas, sea un closet, un cobertizo o una reparacion puntual. Respondemos directo, sin formularios ni intermediarios.
texto.en: Tell us what you need, whether it is a closet, a shed or a one-off repair. We answer directly, no forms, no middlemen.

texto.es: Vamos al lugar, revisamos el alcance real del trabajo y te damos un presupuesto claro antes de empezar.
texto.en: We visit the property, review the real scope of the work and give you a clear quote before any work starts.

texto.es: Ejecutamos el proyecto con el mismo cuidado que ves en nuestras fotos: medidas exactas, buen material y acabado prolijo.
texto.en: We carry out the project with the same care you see in our photos: accurate measurements, solid materials and a tidy finish.

titulo.en: We walk through and hand over

texto.es: Revisamos juntos el resultado y dejamos el area limpia. El trabajo queda listo para usarse el mismo dia.
texto.en: We walk the result through with you and leave the area clean. The job is ready to use the same day.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza segun el material y el alcance del proyecto. Escribenos y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on materials and scope. Message us and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Closets, despensas y gabinetes de garaje a medida, pensados para aprovechar cada centimetro de tu casa.
texto.en: Custom closets, pantries and garage cabinetry, built to make use of every inch of your home.

texto.es: Construccion e instalacion de cobertizos de patio, paredes de privacidad y estructuras exteriores a medida.
texto.en: Construction and installation of backyard sheds, privacy walls and custom outdoor structures.

texto.es: Instalacion de pisos, cielorrasos y acabados interiores, de una habitacion puntual a una remodelacion completa.
texto.en: Flooring installation, ceiling work and interior finishes, from a single room to a full renovation.

texto.es: Caminos de piedra, jardines y reparaciones generales de la casa: desde un buzon de madera hasta una pared de bloque.
texto.en: Stone walkways, yard work and general home repairs, from a wooden mailbox to a block wall.

pie.es: ¿No ves exactamente lo que necesitas? Escribenos igual: la mayoria de nuestros trabajos empiezan como un proyecto puntual.
pie.en: Do not see exactly what you need? Reach out anyway: most of our work starts out as a one-off request.

items.quote: Joel repaired and repainted my garage cabinets and countertop, fixed my wooden mailbox, extended my flower bed, and repainted my workbench. The quality of his work was excellent, professional, efficient, and detail-oriented.
I had no idea who could help on a privacy wall on my lanai that had some rot, and asked a fb group. Joel was highly recommended by several users.
Joel was extremely helpful and took care of our home projects as if it were his own home. Great communication and flexibility was much appreciated. 100% recommend for any home improvement needs.
